senses.gloss: m. ch. (קְטַר II) the upper garment with the girdle, walking cloak or sheet.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:2:3">Y. B. Mets. II, beg. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אשכח … כריך במ׳</he> found a web wrapped up in a cloak.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 58b:8">Ab. Zar. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>אדמִקְטוֹרָךְ עלך וכ׳</he> before you take off your cloak, go back (and rescind your decision).
